evidence: development validation history; not acceptance substitution

events.finding: Original client bootstrap required a room ID and blocked a fresh central registry with roomId:null.
events.resolution: Accept explicit null and derive channels only from authenticated membership. Normal production UI with real empty Core/Synapse registered the first account and created its first room.

events.finding: Initial origin validator rejected existing HTTP private same-origin deployments and private Matrix discovery.
events.resolution: Allow the actual browser origin as the original credential target; permit its bound Matrix metadata; keep new split-origin targets restricted. Unit and route-backed ordinary-private-HTTP production-entry checks pass.

events.finding: HTTP nonsecure browser contexts do not expose crypto.randomUUID.
events.resolution: Use crypto.getRandomValues to generate request/upload IDs when randomUUID is absent. Production entry sent a synthetic API message under its original full identity.

events.finding: First normal-entry fixture attempted a hidden message toolbar button without hover.
events.resolution: Use the actual hover interaction, then click Reply; no product pointer-events bypass.

events.finding: Old SettingsDialog fixture expected roles in personal settings, and mocked active service worker lacked postMessage.
events.resolution: Exercise separate RolesDialog entry; capability-check worker messaging; original bot status rerender remains stable.
